## **Banco Macro announces Results for the Third Quarter of 2026**


****


**Buenos Aires, Argentina, November 25, 2026** – Banco Macro S.A. (NYSE: BMA; BYMA: BMA) (“Banco Macro” or “BMA” or the “Bank”) announced today its results for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026 (“3Q26”). All figures are in Argentine pesos (Ps.) and have been restated in terms of the measuring unit current at the end of the reporting period. As of 1Q20, the Bank began reporting results applying Hyperinflation Accounting, in accordance with IFRS IAS 29 as established by the Central Bank. For ease of comparison, figures of previous quarters of 2025 and 2026 have been restated applying IAS 29 to reflect the accumulated effect of the inflation adjustment for each period through September 30, 2026.


**Summary**


**• **Banco Macro’s Net income decreased 64% QoQ to ARS 78.4B, mainly driven by lower net interest income, lower results from financial instruments at fair value, lower other operating income, and higher other operating expenses. Net interest income decreased 15% QoQ and increased 2% YoY** .**


**Annualized ROAE and ROAA reached 4.6% and 1.2%, respectively. The quarter included ARS 39.6 billion in restructuring expenses (ARS 25.7 billion after tax) related to early retirement plans and severance provisions. Excluding these expenses, adjusted net income totaled ARS 104.1 billion, with annualized adjusted ROAE of 6.2% and ROAA of 1.6%**


**• **In 3Q26 Net Interest Margin reached 20.5% down 360 bps QoQ and 180 bps YoY. NIM declined mainly due to a lower FX and Income from securities contribution. Excluding FX and Securities, NIM decreased 200 bps from 17.6% in 2Q26 to 15.6% in 3Q26** .**


**• **In 3Q26, Total financing decreased 3% QoQ to ARS 11.97tn, mainly driven by commercial lending, particularly overdrafts which decreased 19% QoQ. Peso-denominated financing decreased 7% QoQ (ARS 645.1 billion), while US dollar-denominated financing grew 6% in USD terms (USD 120 million).** **** .**


**• **In 3Q26,** **Total deposits decreased 2% QoQ to ARS 15.22tn, driven by a 7% decline in private-sector time deposits, partially offset by higher public-sector deposits** **.****


**• **In 3Q26 the efficiency ratio stood at 40.1%, a sharp decrease YoY, as disciplined execution on the efficiency transformation continued** .**


**• **Banco Macro’s Tier 1 capital ratio remained strong at 34.2%, with ARS 4.8tn in excess capital. This capital strength provides capacity to support organic and inorganic strategic opportunities. Liquidity remained appropriate, with liquid assets at 75% of deposits. Loans-to-deposits was almost unchanged QoQ at 78%** .**


**• **In 3Q26, Banco Macro’s Reported NPLs increased 15 bps to 6.4%, partly reflecting mandatory system reclassifications, while Stage 3 increased 58bp to 4.66%. Asset quality remained stronger than that of the system: lower NPLs (6.4% vs. 7.1%) and higher coverage (104.27% vs. 88.2%)** .**


**• **As of 3Q26, through its 394 branches and 8.025 employees Banco Macro serves 6.39 million retail customers across 23 of the 24 Provinces in Argentina and over 230.897 corporate customers** .**
